SPECIMEN TYPE: Peripheral blood
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

TEST PERFORMED
Karyotype Analysis - G-banded chromosome analysis

CLINICAL INDICATION
Rule out Down syndrome

RESULT
46,XX
Normal female karyotype

No trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities detected.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
G-banded analysis performed at 400-450 band resolution
15 metaphases analyzed
Sample quality adequate for numerical and major structural abnormality detection only

INTERPRETATION
Normal karyotype rules out Down syndrome. This analysis can detect numerical abnormalities and structural rearrangements larger than 5-10 Mb. Smaller deletions, duplications, or balanced rearrangements may not be detected at this resolution.

NOTE: This report supersedes previous rapid PCR analysis performed on [redacted date].

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
